title: A multi-session simultaneous EEG-fMRI dataset with online experience sampling
description: This dataset comprises simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings from 24 healthy adults performing a sustained attention task (GradCPT) and a resting-state task with intermittent multi-dimensional experience sampling, collected across two sessions per participant. It includes behavioral responses, experience sampling ratings across 13 dimensions of thought, and mental health survey data, enabling study of the neural correlates of attentional fluctuations, mind-wandering, and the reliability of EEG-fMRI relationships across sessions.
methods_description: MRI data were acquired on a 3.0T Siemens MAGNETOM Prisma scanner using a 64-channel head coil adapted for EEG-fMRI, including MPRAGE structural scans, B0 field maps, and multiband EPI BOLD sequences. EEG data were recorded using an MR-compatible Brain Products system with 31 cortical channels, 4 carbon wire loop sensors for artifact correction, and an ECG channel, sampled at 5kHz and synchronized with MRI TR markers.
